env GOPROXY=off

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^name$'
logos eject -o out
! grep -E 'Logos_Get|Logos_Set' out/main.go
cd out

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constmethod

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Readable interface {
	const Name() string
}

type Thing struct{}

func (Thing) Name() string {
	return "name"
}

func use(r Readable) string {
	return r.Name()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(use(Thing{}))
}
